sql: SELECT c.name, c.is_active, c.parent_id IS NOT NULL AS tem_matriz, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = c.id) AS leads, (SELECT max(l.created_at)::date FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = c.id) AS ult_lead, (SELECT count(*) FROM company_events e WHERE e.company_id = c.id) AS festas, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_conversations w WHERE w.company_id = c.id) AS conversas, (SELECT count(*) FROM user_companies u WHERE u.company_id = c.id) AS usuarios, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(i.provider, 'wapi') || ':' || coalesce(i.status, '?') || ':' || coalesce(i.unit, '-') || ':' || coalesce(i.updated_at::date::text, ''), ' | ') FROM wapi_instances i WHERE i.company_id = c.id) AS instancias, (SELECT count(*) FROM company_landing_pages p WHERE p.company_id = c.id) AS landing, c.custom_domain FROM companies c WHERE c.slug IN ('espaco-carrossel', 'infesta', 'hub-celebrei') ORDER BY c.name
